question: Which of the following movies has been selected as India’s official entry for the ‘International Feature Film’ category at the 93rd Academy Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jallikattu.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jallikattu** is a **Malayalam feature film directed by Lijo Jose Pellissery.**
 
• It has been selected as India's official entry for the International Feature Film category at the 93rd Academy Awards 2020, the Film Federation of India (FFI) announced.
 
• Gully Boy is a Hindi feature film that has been selected as India's official entry for the International Feature Film category at the 92nd Academy Awards 2019.
 
• Village Rockstars is an Assamese film feature that has been selected as India's official entry for the International Feature Film category at the 91st Academy Awards 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• The Academy Award is popularly known as **the Oscar award** is the highest international award in the field of film given by the** United States Academy ****of Motion Pictures of Arts and Science (AMPAS)**. 
 
• In **1929**, the Oscar award was first presented.
 
• The Oscar award statue is designed by** Cedric Gibbons**.
 
• The first Indian to win Oscar award - **Bhanu Athaiya (1982)**.
 
• The first Indian to win two Oscar awards -** A. R. Rahman**.
